requirement.description: The external() function is failing with AttributeError when processing bytes objects in encoding tests. The error suggests bytes objects are being treated as dictionaries and having .items() called on them. This occurs when external snapshots contain binary data that should be handled properly.
requirement.contract: When external() is used with bytes objects or other non-dictionary data types, the function should properly serialize and store the data without attempting to call dictionary methods on non-dictionary objects.

requirement.description: UUID storage mechanism is throwing KeyError when looking up external files. The lookup path resolution fails to properly locate existing UUID files, causing storage tests to fail with KeyError: 'uuid'.
requirement.contract: The UUID storage should properly resolve and manage external snapshot files by UUID, ensuring that when a file is referenced by UUID, it can be correctly located and accessed without throwing KeyError exceptions.

requirement.description: The __eq__ method in the External class has issues with missing value handling when comparing external values. This causes assertion failures in formatting tests when external snapshots are compared against actual values.
requirement.contract: The External.__eq__ method should correctly handle comparison scenarios where external values are missing or need to be created, returning appropriate boolean results and managing state correctly.
